scriptDescription: Keep code, math, and editors untranslated during full-page translation, including dynamically added content.
pageTitle: Prevent Code Translation — Keep code original
pageDescription: Read translated documentation without translating its code. A free Tampermonkey userscript for code blocks, math, editors, and dynamically added content.

hero.body: Read documentation in your language while keeping code, commands, and formulas in their original form.
hero.existing: Already installed? Use Check for updates in Tampermonkey.
hero.compatibility: Your translator must respect “do not translate” markers.

coverage.title: Keep the parts that need to be exact.

items.title: Code & commands
items.body: Code blocks, inline code, keyboard shortcuts, and explicitly marked code containers.

items.title: Math & editors
items.body: Formulas, variables, and supported editing areas. Ordinary page text remains translatable.

items.title: Content loaded later
items.body: New content from infinite scrolling, load more, and lazy loading, with repair of removed exclusion markers.

trust: Runs in your browser. No account. No page uploads.

steps.title: Add Tampermonkey
steps.body: Install the userscript manager in your browser.

steps.title: Add this script
steps.body: Use the install button and confirm in Tampermonkey. Choose one installation source.

steps.title: Reload, then translate
steps.body: Reload the page you want to read, then start your usual translator.

items.question: Will it work with my translator?
items.answer: Only if your translator honors translation-exclusion markers. The installation check verifies those markers, not compatibility with a specific translator. The script cannot restore text already translated.

items.question: Why does it run on all websites?
items.answer: So it can protect code on whichever page you translate. It adds exclusion markers locally and does not send page contents to a server. Some closed Shadow DOM and restricted frames cannot be reached.

items.question: How do updates work?
items.answer: Enable automatic update checks in Tampermonkey. Updates arrive periodically from your installation source, so a new release may not appear immediately. Reload open pages after updating. No reinstall needed.
